paths.name: next
paths.message: src/lib and src/worker stay framework-free so the worker and CLI scripts can run them. Keep Next code in src/app or src/server.

paths.name: react
paths.message: src/lib and src/worker stay framework-free so the worker and CLI scripts can run them. Keep React code in src/app or src/components.

paths.name: react-dom
paths.message: src/lib and src/worker stay framework-free so the worker and CLI scripts can run them. Keep React code in src/app or src/components.

paths.name: server-only
paths.message: server-only throws outside Next, which would break the worker, the CLI scripts and the tests. Only src/server may import it.

patterns.message: src/lib and src/worker stay framework-free so the worker and CLI scripts can run them. Keep Next code in src/app or src/server.
src/lib and src/worker stay framework-free so the worker and CLI scripts can run them. Keep React code in src/app or src/components.
src/lib and src/worker can't depend on the Next app. Move the shared logic into src/lib and import it from the app instead.
src/lib and src/worker can't depend on UI components. Move the shared logic into src/lib and import it from the component instead.
src/server holds Next-only singletons that import server-only. Move the shared logic into src/lib and import it from src/server instead.
